table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Date=P.Date,
	PurInvCode=P.PurInvCode,
	SuppInvCode=P.SuppInvCode,
	SuppDate = P.SuppInvDate,
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	SupplierName=A.Name,
	NetAmount=P.InvTotal,
	ItemAlias = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	TaxCategory = TC.Name,
	AdvanceTaxPerc = TC.TaxPerc,
	AdvanceTaxAmt = P.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	ItemAdvanceTaxPerc = D.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,
	PurchaseAmt = (SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
		SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.Gstperc * 0.01) +
		SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax)),
	ItemAdvanceTax = ROUND((SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
		SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.PurPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.Gstperc * 0.01) +
		SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax)) * D.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc * 0.01, 2)
FROM
	PurLedger P, PurDetail D, Accounts A, Supplier S, Item I, TaxCategory TC
WHERE
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND
	P.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	P.SuppCode IN (:ai_suppcode) AND
	P.SuppCode = S.SuppCode AND
	S.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
	P.TaxCategoryCode = TC.TaxCategoryCode AND
	P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	P.Date,
	P.PurInvCode,
	P.SuppInvCode,
	P.SuppInvDate,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	P.InvTotal,
	P.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	TC.Name,
	TC.TaxPerc,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	D.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc
table.sort: suppliername A, aliasname A, date A, purinvcode A, itemalias A, itemname A
